description: Find the SSL/TLS certificates issued for a domain from public Certificate Transparency logs (Cert Spotter). PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what certificates does X have", "find subdomains of X", "when does X's TLS cert expire", "which CA issued X's cert". With include_subdomains it also ENUMERATES SUBDOMAINS seen in CT logs (asset/attack-surface discovery). Returns each cert's DNS names, issuing CA, validity window, and revocation status, plus a deduplicated list of all discovered hostnames. Keyless.

domain.description: Domain to search certificates for, e.g. "example.com".

include_subdomains.description: Also include certs covering subdomains (default true) — this is what enables subdomain discovery.

limit.description: Max certificates to list (1-100, default 30). The discovered-hostnames list is always complete.

name: certificate_search
title: Certificate Search
